book.identity: o = alpha_hat g_r(w_r |beta_hat g_c(w_c x + b)| + p) with alpha_hat = T pinv(G_r); every output is T (pinv(G_r) g_r(.)), an element of span(T); the biases b and p sit inside g_c and g_r and eq. 15.1 has no output bias. The IEM (CNN) acts after the NMM and is not confined to span(T), so the bound applies to the NMM column only.

readings.span: book eqs. 15.1-15.6 as printed: o in span(T)
readings.span_const: span(T u {1}): an additive output bias (not in eq. 15.1)
readings.shift_clip: in-span output + oracle shift along Pi_T 1, clipped to the colorbar [1, 2]
